Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
[D5:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?

Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You?
[D6:2] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
[D6:3] Jolene: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.
[D6:4] Deborah: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
[D6:5] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[...]
[D6:9] Jolene: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?
[D6:10] Deborah: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.
[D6:11] Jolene: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.
[...]
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

Session date: 11:46 am on 30 August, 2023
[D23:3] Jolene: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?
[D23:4] Deborah: Yep, last month I visited my mom`s house which holds a special place in my heart. My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me. This is my husband in front of this house.
[D23:5] Jolene: What was it like?
[D23:6] Deborah: It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.
[D23:7] Jolene: Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.
[D23:8] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?
[...]
[D23:18] Deborah: Wow, exploring those temples must have been incredible! Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions.
[D23:19] Jolene: The architecture and history of it all were really interesting. I'm sure you also liked the places you visited there!
[D23:20] Deborah: Exploring historical places and learning their stories is so fun. It was a great experience. I want to share this photo with you.
[...]
Session date: 8:31 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D25:1] Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited!
[D25:2] Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!
[D25:3] Jolene:  It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
[D25:4] Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.

Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:2] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
[D2:3] Deborah: Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
[D2:4] Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
[...]
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.

Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:4] Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
[D29:5] Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
[D29:6] Jolene: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?
[...]
[D29:23] Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!

Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:12] Jolene: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
[D15:13] Deborah: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
[D15:14] Jolene:  Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
[...]
[D15:18] Jolene:  I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
[D15:19] Deborah:  Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
[D15:20] Jolene: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her.
[...]
[D15:28] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
[D15:29] Deborah: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
[D15:30] Jolene: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
[...]
[D15:32] Jolene: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this
[D15:33] Deborah: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
[D15:34] Jolene: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
